questions.q: What is the maximum number of recipients allowed per day in Milestone 1.0Z batch expansion?
Can follow-up emails be sent automatically to hot leads from 1.0Y?
questions.a: No. Follow-up sends require an explicit OWNER_APPROVED_LIVE_TOKEN matching the correct action_id. No automatic follow-ups are permitted.

questions.q: What happens if a recipient is found in the suppression registry?
questions.a: The send is hard-blocked. No suppressed recipient can receive any outreach regardless of consent status.

questions.q: What are the two lanes in Milestone 1.0Z?
questions.a: Follow-up lane (hot leads from 1.0Y with owner-approved token) and Batch outreach lane (new recipients from allowlist, dry-run by default).

questions.q: What verdict options exist in batch-outcome-readiness-scorecard.json?
questions.a: Three verdicts: APPROVED_FOR_NEXT_BATCH, HOLD_FOR_OWNER_REVIEW, or PAUSED_BY_SAFETY_THRESHOLD.

questions.q: What secrets are forbidden in committed artifacts?
questions.a: Raw email addresses, sk- tokens, OPENAI_API_KEY, RESEND_API_KEY, and any live owner-approved tokens.

questions.q: What is the opt-out threshold rate that triggers a batch pause?
What is the bounce rate threshold that triggers a batch pause?
What does the sales handoff package contain?
questions.a: Redacted recipient, interest classification, recommended next action, approved draft, meeting/demo CTA, and owner approval state. No real CRM write in 1.0Z.

questions.q: What is the next milestone after 1.0Z?
questions.a: Milestone 1.1A — Revenue Conversation Loop / CRM Integration Gate.
